title: Otter.ai Pricing 2026: Free, Pro & Business Plans
summary: Otter.ai pricing structures for 2026 determine which subscription tier best fits your meeting volume and team collaboration requirements.
body_markdown:
## Otter.AI pricing plans for 2026 explained


Tier Price (Billed Annually) Monthly Minute Limit


Basic Free 300 mins/mo


Pro $8.33/user/mo 1200 mins/mo


Business $19.99/user/mo Unlimited mins


Enterprise Custom pricing Advanced security


*Prices and plan limits checked against[otter.ai](https://otter.ai/purchase/team) on October 10, 2026.*


Because the Business tier charges for every seat, many organizations use automation to move transcripts into a shared database. This allows them to keep the paid user count low without losing access to historical meeting data.


### Otter.AI Basic plan features explained


The Basic plan is for individuals to test the transcription engine on a limited number of calls each month.


Because this tier enforces a strict monthly minute ceiling, a user who reaches the limit mid-meeting will see the recording stop, resulting in a partial transcript that misses the end of the conversation.


It includes the ability to record live meetings and playback audio at different speeds. However, it lacks the administrative controls necessary to manage data sharing across a larger company.


### The Pro individual plan costs


The Pro plan is for power users who require a higher monthly allowance than the free version provides.


By increasing the minute cap, this tier ensures that a consultant or freelancer can record multiple hour-long sessions every week without running out of credits before the month resets.


The Pro plan also expands the duration of individual recordings. Each conversation can last up to 90 minutes, which accommodates standard workshops and deep-dive interviews that the free tier would cut off.


It also introduces the ability to import pre-recorded audio files. This means a user can generate text from a memo recorded on a phone or a downloaded webinar.


### The Business team plan limits


The Business plan removes the monthly minute restrictions for all members, but it introduces a per-user cost that can quickly exceed a department's budget if the company invites every employee.


This tier is the entry point for organizations that need centralized billing and shared folders, so a manager can review notes from a meeting they didn't attend.


For long-form events, the Business plan allows for a single conversation to last up to 4 hours, ensuring that even the most extensive seminars or multi-part discussions can be captured in their entirety.


This extended limit is designed for half-day seminars or executive retreats where continuous recording is essential for a complete record.


Alan and Funding Societies run production automation on Activepieces, where the credit-based structure makes headcount irrelevant to the total cost.


By metering consumption instead of seats and providing unlimited flows on every plan, the platform allows a company to scale its transcription syncs to every department without the bill increasing for every new employee who needs access to the data.


### Enterprise and custom scale pricing


On the Enterprise tier, organization-wide security features like Single Sign-On (SSO) and domain capture are the only options. By using SSO, an IT department ensures that a terminated employee immediately loses access to sensitive meeting transcripts, preventing data leaks during offboarding.


This plan requires a direct consultation with the sales team to negotiate rates based on total headcount and specific compliance needs. These needs include HIPAA or advanced data retention policies that aren't available on the standard retail plans.
